summary: Manage agents as a measured portfolio of capabilities and authorities rather than a static organization chart.

items.text: Maintain a role card with allowed tools, model, budget, evidence requirements, escalation path and recent calibrated performance by task class.
Route first to the smallest topology likely to succeed; add specialists only when an uncertainty, dependency or independent check warrants them.
Run periodic ablations against single-agent and human-assisted baselines to retire roles whose coordination cost exceeds their measured contribution.
Use Orchestrator / Subagent as the execution topology that assigns bounded jobs to roles selected from the workforce portfolio.
Give concurrent implementation roles isolated Worktree Fan-Out workspaces so portfolio parallelism does not become repository contention.
Place each role at a named Agent Pipelines & Triggered Roles stage instead of invoking an informal roster ad hoc.
Qualify each role's model against its task classes with Model–Task Capability Mapping; a role name is not evidence of capability.
Allocate and observe per-role Token Budgets so the portfolio has explicit economic limits and comparable cost evidence.
Attach an Escalation Cascade to every role card so uncertainty, risk and exhausted attempts move through bounded capability tiers.
